items.source: Generate a decorated code block for bean properties.
items.translation:
```xml
<bean id="exampleBean" class="com.example.ExampleBean">
    <property name="name" value="Example Bean"/>
    <property name="age" value="25"/>
    <list>
        <value>Item 1</value>
        <value>Item 2</value>
    </list>
    <map key-type="java.lang.String">
        <entry key="key1" value="value1"/>
        <entry key="key2" value="value2"/>
    </map>
    <set>
        <ref bean="anotherBean"/>
        <ref bean="yetAnotherBean"/>
    </set>
</bean>
```

items.source: NOTE: the RepositoryContributor must be able to provide the to be type name of the generated repository implementation and needs to have potential constructor arguments resolved.
items.translation: 注意：RepositoryContributor 必须能够提供待生成的仓库实现的类型名称，并且需要能够解析潜在的构造函数参数。

items.source: Delegate to decorate AOT BeanDefinition properties during AOT processing. Adds a CodeBlock for the fragment function that resolves RepositoryContributor.getAotFragmentMetadata() from the BeanFactory and provides them to the generated repository fragment.
items.translation: 委托在 AOT 处理期间装饰 AOT BeanDefinition 属性。为解析来自 BeanFactory 的RepositoryContributor.getAotFragmentMetadata() 的代码块添加一个 CodeBlock，并将其提供给生成的存储库片段。
